Name: zstudio_state
Description: Read the visible workspace, document identities, revisions and current preview.

Name: zstudio_capabilities
Description: Read all capability schemas. Unsupported formats remain read-only; MCP does not add binary patching.

Name: zstudio_open_root
Description: Open and index a ZBD root in the visible workspace. Dirty documents must be explicitly saved or closed first. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_files
Description: List recognized files in the current root.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_search
Description: Search indexed assets without altering GUI selection; names are not identities.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_related
Description: List related indexed assets for an explicit asset, retaining source identities.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_asset_filter
Description: Set the Assets list query and kind filter without changing the selected record.

Name: zstudio_open_document
Description: Open or activate an archive and its visible preview. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_assets
Description: List current edited assets by current kind/index. Resource member/script UUIDs remain stable through reordering. Offset/Length describe the edited snapshot; sourceOffset/sourceLength identify original bytes, or are null for newly added records.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_select_asset
Description: Select an asset in the GUI and await its preview; does not retarget Properties. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_inspect_asset
Description: Read original asset metadata/content and a separately frozen edited snapshot at one revision. ZRD/script inspection bounds nodes, instructions and strings with explicit truncation markers; export retains complete data. Closed or changed documents reject stale results.

Name: zstudio_source_bytes
Description: Read at most 4096 original source bytes; these are not pending edits or runtime memory.

Name: zstudio_close_document
Description: Close a document. Explicit discard=true is required for unsaved edits; pending drafts are never discarded implicitly.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: discard
Parameters.Description: Explicitly discard this document's accepted unsaved edits.

Name: zstudio_reload_document
Description: Stage and reparse a clean document before replacing it, using the current model/resource Save As destination. An already-open destination, failure or pre-publication cancellation retains the document and preview. Dirty documents must first be saved or explicitly closed. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_undo_redo
Description: Undo or redo one accepted edit in the specified document.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_save_document
Description: Verified save: animations require a NEW destination outside the source root; pickups save owning archives or explicit new destinations; model edits save all texture variants before GameZ; ZAR/ZRD, script and texture saves verify and atomically replace each working destination or create new Save As files. Content batches return saved paths and errors; state.contentEdits lists affected paths and targets. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: destination
Parameters.Description: New single-file Save As path (animation, ZAR/ZRD, script or texture pack). Omit to save working files.

Parameters.Name: modelDirectory
Parameters.Description: Model Save As directory; all GameZ/texture destinations must be new. Omit for verified save to the working files.

Parameters.Name: destinations
Parameters.Description: Pickup or texture batch source path to new Save As path map; cover every affected file.

AdditionalProperties.Description: New Save As path for this source archive.

Parameters.Name: backup
Parameters.Description: Pickup backup preference; defaults to app setting.

Name: zstudio_export
Description: Export assets through the existing deterministic exporter into a new folder outside the source tree. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: assets
Parameters.Description: Optional list of {kind,index}; omitted exports all.

Name: zstudio_validate
Description: Validate the source archive on disk, not pending edits. Returns structured diagnostics. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_problems
Description: List file/operation problems with original severity and source context.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_operation
Description: Read operation status/result. Poll at sensible intervals; cancel is available only for export/validation.

Parameters.Name: cancel
Parameters.Description: Request cancellation of an export or validation.

Name: zstudio_texture_palette
Description: Read texture header and RGB565 palette entries.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_preview_state
Description: Read active preview options, camera and playback state.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_camera
Description: Read or navigate the shared 3D camera. Supports Blender-style orbit/pan/centered zoom/dolly, exact axis views, perspective/orthographic projection and framing. Valid manual navigation exits animation Follow camera. Never captures physical input.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: fov
Parameters.Description: Perspective camera field of view in degrees; retained in orthographic mode.

Parameters.Name: horizontal
Parameters.Description: Mouse-equivalent delta in DIP for rotate or pan.

Parameters.Name: vertical
Parameters.Description: Mouse-equivalent delta in DIP for rotate or pan.

Parameters.Name: steps
Parameters.Description: Wheel-equivalent zoom steps; positive zooms in around the view target.

Parameters.Name: distance
Parameters.Description: Dolly displacement in game units; positive moves forward together with the target.

Parameters.Name: view
Parameters.Description: Named view for action=view; axis views are orthographic with automatic perspective on orbit.

Parameters.Name: projection
Parameters.Description: Required for action=projection; optional for set. Explicit orthographic mode persists while orbiting.

Parameters.Name: width
Parameters.Description: Orthographic view width in game units, for set or projection.

Parameters.Name: target
Parameters.Description: Frame target; defaults to asset, preserving the existing animation-only framing. Selected falls back to asset without a node selection.

Parameters.Name: node
Parameters.Description: Optional source node identity to frame, including visible descendants/runtime instances.

Name: zstudio_scene_nodes
Description: List active assembled scene nodes by index, including instance metadata.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_scene_selection
Description: Select/inspect a scene node. Isolate and show_all are available only in static model/Whole world previews, matching the GUI.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: action
Parameters.Description: Selection operation; isolate/show_all require a static model or Whole world preview.

Name: zstudio_scene_options
Description: Set static model/world options: lod(integer), difficulty(Easy/Medium/Hard), textures/wireframe/bounds/horizon(boolean), texturePack(path or empty for automatic), highlight(none/nonDefaultSoils/canModify/clipTo), aiNodes/aiThroughGeometry(boolean), aiNetwork(all or ID with aiSnapshot). Highlights and AI are Whole world only. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: changes
Parameters.Description: Static model/world options. Validate the entire batch before applying changes; publish highlights and AI options only after requested refreshes succeed.

Properties.Name: aiNodes
Properties.Description: Whole world: show authored AI nodes and directed links.

Properties.Name: aiThroughGeometry
Properties.Description: Whole world: show AI through scene geometry; false enables depth occlusion.

Properties.Name: aiNetwork
Properties.Description: Whole world: all, or an AI network ID. A specific ID requires aiSnapshot.

Properties.Name: aiSnapshot
Properties.Description: Expected AI graph snapshot from preview_state.ai; required with a specific aiNetwork ID.

Properties.Name: highlight
Properties.Description: Whole world only: solid yellow non-default soils, green CanModify or red ClipTo; none restores normal appearance.

Properties.Name: lod
Properties.Description: Authored LOD rank within the active viewer's available range.

Properties.Name: texturePack
Properties.Description: Available texture pack path, or empty for automatic.

Name: zstudio_animation_options
Description: Set animation options: map/grid/collision/horizon/followCamera/effects/replay/mute/followLog(bool), height(-999..999), lod, difficulty, speed, volume, phase(runtime/cleanup), seed, condition(0/1/2), range/traceRange(seconds), autoRange/fitTrace(true), problemFilter(0..4), worldPath, root, activationOrigin/activationTarget(XYZ text or blank). Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: changes
Parameters.Description: Animation options; only supplied values change.

Properties.Name: activationOrigin
Properties.Description: Comma-separated XYZ, or blank for default.

Properties.Name: activationTarget
Properties.Description: Comma-separated XYZ, or blank for default.

Name: zstudio_animation_transport
Description: Play/pause/stop, frame-step or seek the current animation. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_animation_runtime
Description: Read preview status, sequence runtime, dispatched event occurrences, problems or bound scene nodes. Timing thresholds and observed dispatches remain distinct.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_animation_select
Description: Select an authored sequence/event without changing playback phase or retargeting Properties.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_texture_view
Description: Inspect or set texture presentation. Channels: 0 RGBA, 1 RGB, 2 Alpha, 3 Red, 4 Green, 5 Blue. Coordinates are texture pixels.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_sound_transport
Description: Control the selected sound preview and read waveform/cue metadata.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_capture
Description: Capture the current preview or a zStudio-owned window as PNG; never captures other applications. 3D images fit within width/height without distortion or resizing the viewport. Texture/window captures keep native dimensions.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state; required for target=preview.

Name: zstudio_workspace_view
Description: Read or set presentation preferences and read effective navigatorMode (hidden, tabbed, split). Supports theme, density, preset, pane visibility/dimensions and stable section indices, including detached Files. Does not commit drafts.

Properties.Name: filesWidth
Properties.Description: Preferred detached Files width in DIP, clamped to 200–650; automatic layout does not overwrite it.

Properties.Name: navigatorWidth
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits. Navigator width is the content tabs width in split mode, or the combined tab group width otherwise.

Properties.Name: inspectorWidth
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits. Navigator width is the content tabs width in split mode, or the combined tab group width otherwise.

Properties.Name: toolsHeight
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits. Navigator width is the content tabs width in split mode, or the combined tab group width otherwise.

Properties.Name: navigatorTab
Properties.Description: Stable section index: 0 Files (also when detached), 1 Assets, 2 Search, 3 Document scene. Unavailable document sections are rejected.

Name: zstudio_window
Description: Read or change zStudio window state; close requires clean documents and resolved drafts.

Name: zstudio_properties_open
Description: Open the reusable Properties window for an explicit edited asset or animation sequence/event; current pending drafts must be resolved first. Model records remain pinned by identity through replacement and undo/redo. Concurrent edits reject stale loads.

Name: zstudio_properties_close
Description: Close the Properties window after drafts have been explicitly resolved.

Name: zstudio_properties_state
Description: Read the pinned Properties window identity, content and current editable fields.

Name: zstudio_scene_properties
Description: Inspect a scene node or open its Properties window, including editable mission pickups.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_ai_networks
Description: List authored AI networks with distinct source identities, counts and diagnostics. Does not simulate activation or change visualization.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_ai_nodes
Description: List authored AI nodes, XYZ, raw integer and all three directed link slots. Negative indices mean no link; unresolved targets retain diagnostics.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: snapshot
Parameters.Description: AI graph snapshot from preview_state.ai. Handles apply only to this snapshot.

Parameters.Name: network
Parameters.Description: Network ID, or all/omitted for all networks.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_ai_selection
Description: Select/clear an AI marker or open its pinned read-only Properties. Selection requires enabled visualization and a matching filter. Frame it with camera action=frame,target=selected.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: snapshot
Parameters.Description: AI graph snapshot from preview_state.ai. Handles apply only to this snapshot.

Parameters.Name: node
Parameters.Description: Snapshot-scoped node ID; required except for clear.

Name: zstudio_animation_records
Description: List authored sequence identities; supply sequence to page its events with full edited fields. Cleanup is listed separately from runtime sequences.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Optional sequence UUID for event details.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_references
Description: List authored reference table slots, including raw bytes and reserved/unverified status.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_event_catalog
Description: Describe supported event types, fields and preview limitations.

Name: zstudio_property_fields
Description: Read the same fields, choices, validation hints and actions as animation Properties, without opening or retargeting its window. IDs apply to this target/segment/revision.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Name: zstudio_property_edit
Description: Edit one Properties field using its current field ID and invariant editor text. Components use the delimiter shown in the current value. One undoable edit.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_property_action
Description: Run a currently available Properties action, including add/copy/delete/reorder keyframe segments.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_animation_structure
Description: Add, duplicate, delete or reorder authored sequences/events. Cleanup is not an extra runtime sequence.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_reference_edit
Description: Retarget a verified stored reference name, preserving table indices. Reserved/unverified slots remain read-only.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_pickups
Description: Load/list all authored mission pickup placements and owning archive identities, including difficulty counterparts. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_pickup_lock
Description: Set this document's pickup editing lock; new documents are locked by default.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_pickup_move
Description: Move a pickup to exact coordinates as one undoable operation, including unambiguous difficulty counterparts. Requires unlocked placements.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: source
Parameters.Description: Exact source identity returned by pickups; field names are case-sensitive.

Properties.Name: ArchivePath
Properties.Description: Owning archive path returned by pickups.

Properties.Name: AssetIndex
Properties.Description: Resource asset index returned by pickups.

Properties.Name: RecordIndex
Properties.Description: Placement record index returned by pickups.

Name: zstudio_drafts
Description: Read pending GUI drafts and their conflict token without committing or changing focus.

Name: zstudio_resolve_drafts
Description: Explicitly apply or discard current GUI drafts. Invalid input is retained and returned as an error, without modal dialogs.

Name: zstudio_model_bundle_export
Description: Export all authored models under a node or an animation root as assembled and local OBJ/MTL/PNG files with stable indices, transforms and source fingerprint. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: destination
Parameters.Description: Export folder outside the source tree.

Parameters.Name: rootNode
Parameters.Description: Explicit GameZ root node, required for ambiguous animation roots.

Name: zstudio_model_replace
Description: Validate an explicit version-1 OBJ/PNG replacement manifest, then accept the entire batch as one document undo step. Model indices and source SHA-256 must match. Shared file ownership is acquired before acceptance; conflicting writers leave the document unchanged. Saves use save_document. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_archive_members
Description: List edited resource members in stored order with stable identities and original source indices. Duplicate names are allowed. Standalone ZRD has one member.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_archive_edit
Description: Add, replace, rename, duplicate, delete or reorder a ZAR member as one undoable edit. add_zrd creates an empty array. Names use Latin-1 and are not identities. Move position is the final zero-based index. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Required member UUID except for add/add_zrd.

Name: zstudio_resource_select
Description: Select a member and optional ZRD node by stable UUID in the visible Data tree. Properties retains its pinned target. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Name: zstudio_zrd_nodes
Description: Read an edited typed ZRD root, or page the immediate children of a node. Values use invariant editor text; strings are JSON-quoted, floats include raw bits. Formatting is bounded to a 4096-character prefix with valueTruncated; truncated text may be incomplete JSON. Node IDs survive edits and undo. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Parameters.Name: node
Parameters.Description: Optional parent node UUID; omit to return the root.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_zrd_edit
Description: Edit typed ZRD values or structure as one undoable operation. add inserts in the selected array. move uses parent UUID and final position after removal. Root deletion/duplication and cycles are rejected. Changing type replaces the old value/children. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Parameters.Name: node
Parameters.Description: Stable ZRD node UUID from zrd_nodes.

Parameters.Name: value
Parameters.Description: Invariant int/float, explicit 0xXXXXXXXX float bits, or JSON-quoted Latin-1 string.

Parameters.Name: position
Parameters.Description: Final child index; add defaults to append.

Name: zstudio_resource_properties
Description: Read generated resource Properties fields, open the pinned Properties window, or edit one current field. Node omitted targets the member. Values exceeding 16384 displayed characters use a read-only prefix; zrd_edit can replace the complete value and export retains full data. Editing requires revision and rejects pending drafts. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: member
Parameters.Description: Stable member UUID from archive_members or assets.

Parameters.Name: value
Parameters.Description: Invariant field editor text for edit.

Name: zstudio_texture_targets
Description: Discover sibling texture packs with matching names. Default replacement is this pack only. Duplicate matches require explicit record indices. Names are not identities. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_texture_import
Description: Replace a texture from RGB/RGBA PNG (16 MiB; up to 4096×4096), or add a named texture when index is omitted. Replacement dimensions must match the selected record. Explicit sibling targets retain their dimensions, using premultiplied-alpha resampling and private palettes for indexed records. One undo step owns the complete batch. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: index
Parameters.Description: Texture to replace; omit to add.

Parameters.Name: name
Parameters.Description: New texture name, required when adding.

Parameters.Name: targets
Parameters.Description: Optional explicit replacement targets, including the selected record; one per sibling pack, maximum 64.

Name: zstudio_script_records
Description: Page scripts in stored order, or instructions of one script. UUIDs survive edits and undo. Token previews are capped at 64 characters and 16 tokens; source offsets refer to original bytes.

Parameters.Name: script
Parameters.Description: Optional script UUID to list instructions.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_script_entry_edit
Description: Add, duplicate, rename, delete, reorder or set the stored timestamp of a script. Unknown commands and unrelated bytes are preserved. No scripts execute and names/references are not rewritten. New timestamps default to zero. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_script_instruction_edit
Description: Add, replace tokens, duplicate, delete or reorder an instruction. Tokens contain command followed by ordered arguments: 1–16 Latin-1 strings, no NUL, each at most 16384 characters. Move position is the final index; add defaults to append. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: tokens
Parameters.Description: Complete command and arguments for add/set.

Name: zstudio_script_select
Description: Select a script and optional instruction in the visible workspace, retaining the pinned Properties target. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_script_properties
Description: Read generated fields/actions, open pinned script/instruction Properties, edit a field, or invoke an argument action. Field tokens are JSON-quoted. Mutations require revision and no pending drafts. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.
